name: hermes_cli_commands_get_suggestion
notes: Slash-command ghost-text suggestion (still-typing branch): shortest matching registry command wins; exact match and gateway-only commands excluded. Harness is a traced copy of commands_wrappers.c::cmd_get_suggestion walking the REAL C registry (linked via extra_src); twin drives the LIVE SlashCommandAutoSuggest.get_suggestion with completer=None over the same ladder. Per-command iteration emits no cup events because C's CLI_COMMAND_REGISTRY (83 names, declaration order) and LIVE's COMMANDS map (alias-inclusive, length-sorted) differ in membership/order — only the resolved remainder is the contract. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (excluded inputs): prefixes where the registries resolve different shortest commands (/re, /b, /s, /t, /i, /h, /in, /lo, /memory, /learn, ...), empty word '' (LIVE would suggest from startswith(''), C returns NULL), non-slash input (LIVE falls back to history suggestions by design).
